hints.title: Set Intersections
hints.text: Convert each row of property values into a collection of unique elements so that intersection sizes can be computed without duplicate counting.

hints.title: Construct Graph Edges
hints.text: For every pair of rows (i, j), count the distinct common elements between their sets. Connect row i and row j with an undirected edge if that count is at least k.

hints.title: Count Connected Components
hints.text: Traverse the constructed graph using a traversal algorithm or disjoint set union to count how many disjoint components exist.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: M: maximum length of a property list
complexity.notes: Pairwise intersection calculation between N items followed by linear traversal.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Without set conversion, finding common distinct items takes quadratic time per pair.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Adjacency lists and sets take polynomial auxiliary space well within limits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use sets for intersection counting and standard component traversal.
